content.name: soulbot_aibp_bot_commercial v2.1.0

output_mode.L0: Output JSON in ENGLISH: {action, transaction_id, state, terms, amount}
output_mode.L1: Output helpfully in User's exact language and script variant

content.description: AIBP Commercial & Transactional Behaviors module — enables AI agents to negotiate proposals, formalize contracts, handle invoicing, and resolve disputes per AIBP §13. 9 transaction message types. v2.0.0: B10 batch operations support — batch_propose (send proposals to multiple agents), batch_invoice (issue invoices for multiple transactions), batch_status_check (check status of multiple transactions). Batch operations use sequential processing with per-item error handling and aggregate result reporting. PCI-DSS v4.0.1 scope: service-level transactions only. Enforces Axiom 0: operator authorization, transparency, revocability, audit trail.

action.agentic_prompt: Extracted by CommercialPipeline in main module.

target_agent.agentic_prompt: Transaction counterparty extracted from user message.

transaction_id.description: Existing transaction ID for follow-up actions.

terms.description: Transaction terms: {service_description, deliverables, price: {amount, currency}, timeline, conditions}

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start([Start]) --> DetermineAction[DetermineAction]
    DetermineAction -->|negotiate| NegotiatePhase[NegotiatePhase]
    DetermineAction -->|formalize| FormalizePhase[FormalizePhase]
    DetermineAction -->|dispute| DisputePhase[DisputePhase]
    DetermineAction -->|query| QueryTransaction[QueryTransaction]
    NegotiatePhase --> CommercialTrustGate[CommercialTrustGate]
    FormalizePhase --> CommercialTrustGate
    DisputePhase --> CommercialTrustGate
    CommercialTrustGate -->|pass| CommercialSafetyAudit[CommercialSafetyAudit]
    CommercialTrustGate -->|fail| RejectTransaction[RejectTransaction]
    CommercialSafetyAudit -->|approved| OperatorApproval[OperatorApproval]
    CommercialSafetyAudit -->|blocked| RejectTransaction
    OperatorApproval -->|confirmed| SendTransaction[SendTransaction]
    OperatorApproval -->|denied| RejectTransaction
    SendTransaction --> SaveTransaction[SaveTransaction]
    QueryTransaction --> End((End))
    RejectTransaction --> End
    SaveTransaction --> End

steps: step1: [ASSERT] Valid parameters received. Required: action, aibp_address, workspace_dir. | Validate action. Route: propose/counter/accept/reject → NegotiatePhase, contract/invoice/receipt → FormalizePhase, dispute/arbitrate → DisputePhase, list/info → QueryTransaction.
step2: For follow-ups: validate transaction_id, load transaction state.
step3: Validate state machine: PROPOSE→COUNTER|ACCEPT|REJECT, ACCEPT→CONTRACT, CONTRACT→INVOICE, INVOICE→RECEIPT|DISPUTE, DISPUTE→ARBITRATE.
constraints: State machine strictly enforced per §13. SECURITY: transaction_id alphanumeric + hyphens only.

PCI-DSS v4.0.1 SCOPE EXCLUSION: This module processes service-level transaction metadata (descriptions, terms, timelines) only. It does NOT process, store, or transmit payment card data (PAN, CVV, expiry). Any future payment integration MUST use tokenization via a PCI-DSS-compliant payment processor API. Direct handling of cardholder data is prohibited. PCI-DSS v4.0.1 ANNUAL SCOPE REVIEW (QS-4 v1.7.0): Per PCI-DSS v4.0.1, annual scope review is now mandatory (previously best practice). Operator must verify annually that this module remains out of PCI-DSS scope by confirming: (a) no payment card data flows have been added, (b) tokenization is used for any payment integration, (c) no cardholder data is stored or transits through this module. Record scope review date in workspace_dir/commercial/pci_scope_review.json.

NegotiatePhase.description: Handle proposal negotiation: PROPOSE, COUNTER, ACCEPT, REJECT per §13
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action in [propose,counter,accept,reject]. | PROPOSE: validate terms, generate transaction_id. COUNTER: load original, validate changes, increment round (max 10). ACCEPT: mark accepted. REJECT: require reason, mark final.
step2: Compose L0 metadata with transaction context. Route to CommercialTrustGate.
constraints: T2 required. Max 10 rounds. Clear terms (Axiom 0). Rejection is final.

FormalizePhase.description: Handle formalization: CONTRACT, INVOICE, RECEIPT per §13
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: transaction_id, action in [contract,invoice,receipt]. | CONTRACT: formalize accepted terms. INVOICE: generate from contract. RECEIPT: confirm completion.
step2: Compose L0 metadata. Route to CommercialTrustGate.
constraints: T3 required. Full audit trail. RECEIPT is final state.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: transaction_id, action in [dispute,arbitrate]. | DISPUTE: record reason, freeze transaction. ARBITRATE: request third-party review.
step2: Compose L0 metadata. Route to CommercialTrustGate.
constraints: DISPUTE: T2. ARBITRATE: T3. Disputes freeze transactions. Arbitration voluntary.

CommercialTrustGate.description: Validate trust requirements for commercial transactions
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Phase node executed. Required: transaction_data, message_type. | Call soulbot_aibp_bot.trust CheckPermission. T2 negotiate, T3 formalize.
step2: VELOCITY CHECK: >5 transactions/hour → advisory confirmation.
step3: IDENTITY VERIFICATION: verify aibp_address matches Identity Card.
step4: Pass → CommercialSafetyAudit. Fail → RejectTransaction.
constraints: Trust gate MANDATORY. No bypass. Re-validated per action.

CommercialSafetyAudit.description: Safety and fraud audit for commercial transactions
steps: step1: [ASSERT] CommercialTrustGate passed. Required: transaction_content. | Call soulbot_aibp_bot.safety ContentAudit.
step2: FRAUD DETECTION: unrealistic promises, price manipulation (>50% change), hidden conditions, exploitation patterns.

step2b: BEHAVIORAL BASELINE FRAUD DETECTION (RF-6): Load counterparty transaction history from workspace_dir/commercial/history/{counterparty_hash}.json. Compute behavioral baseline: {avg_transaction_value, typical_transaction_types, avg_negotiation_rounds, typical_timeline_days, interaction_frequency}. Compare current transaction against baseline: (a) transaction value > 3x avg_transaction_value → FLAG as unusual_amount, (b) transaction type never seen from this counterparty → FLAG as new_pattern, (c) negotiation rounds < 1 when historical avg > 3 → FLAG as rushed_deal, (d) timeline < 50% of typical → FLAG as pressure_timeline. If 2+ flags triggered → route to FlagContent with fraud_advisory. If counterparty has no history (first transaction) → apply stricter static checks and note first_transaction_advisory in audit log.
step3: Call soulbot_aibp_bot.safety PrivacyGate: financial PII → FORBIDDEN, terms → PERMITTED, descriptions → FREE.
step4: Pass → OperatorApproval. Fail → RejectTransaction.
constraints: Safety MANDATORY per §13 Axiom 0. Financial PII always FORBIDDEN.

OperatorApproval.description: Require human operator approval for binding commercial actions
steps: step1: [ASSERT] CommercialSafetyAudit passed. Required: transaction_summary. | Present full summary: type, parties, terms, amount, timeline.
step2: Request explicit confirmation. Confirmed → SendTransaction. Denied → RejectTransaction.
constraints: MANDATORY for ALL commercial actions (Axiom 0). NEVER auto-approve.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] OperatorApproval confirmed. Required: approved_transaction. | Compose via soulbot_aibp_bot.messaging with commercial L0.
step2: Send via email_smtp. Verify success.
step3: Call soulbot_aibp_bot.reputation and soulbot_aibp_bot.trust record.
step4: Route to SaveTransaction.
constraints: Only operator-approved. Full L0 metadata for traceability.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: action in [list_transactions,transaction_info]. | LIST: all transactions. INFO: specific transaction full history.
step2: Display with state, terms, audit trail.
step1: [ASSERT] Trust, safety, or operator check failed. | Determine reason. Inform user. Log to rejected_log.jsonl.
constraints: Rejected MUST NOT proceed. Append-only log.

SaveTransaction.description: Persist transaction data with pre-transaction snapshot for rollback capability
steps: step1: [ASSERT] SendTransaction completed. Required: transaction_data, workspace_dir. | PRE-TRANSACTION SNAPSHOT (RF-10 TRiSM): Before writing new state, save current transaction state (if exists) to workspace_dir/commercial/snapshots/{transaction_id}_{timestamp}.json as rollback point. Snapshot includes: previous_state, previous_terms, snapshot_timestamp, snapshot_reason.
step2: Write to workspace_dir/commercial/transactions/{transaction_id}.json. Write activity log. Update index.

step3: Update counterparty behavioral history at workspace_dir/commercial/history/{counterparty_hash}.json: append {transaction_id, transaction_type, value, timestamp, negotiation_rounds, timeline_days} for RF-6 behavioral baseline tracking.

step4: Immutable history — new entries only. ROLLBACK CAPABILITY: If a subsequent operation fails (e.g., send failure after state update), restore from latest snapshot: read workspace_dir/commercial/snapshots/{transaction_id}_latest.json and overwrite transaction state. Log rollback event to audit trail.
constraints: Atomic write. Append-only log. Immutable history. Full audit trail per §13. Snapshots retained for 90 days for rollback capability (RF-10 TRiSM).

_circuit_breaker_config.description: Circuit-breaker operational thresholds per RF-5 best practices
_circuit_breaker_config.half_open_strategy: Single test request with timeout. If passes → close circuit. If fails → re-open circuit for another cooldown period.

Error.DetermineAction: Invalid action or state transition → explain current state and valid actions
Error.NegotiatePhase: Fails → inform (missing terms, max rounds, invalid counter)
Error.DisputePhase: Fails → inform (no active transaction, already resolved)

endNode.output: Return commercial result with transaction state and audit reference.
constraints: Axiom 0 compliance. No counterparty financial details beyond agreed terms.
